data_description.region: The AWS region to use Amazon Bedrock in. Not all models are available in every region.
data_description.access_key_id: The access key ID of an IAM user that is allowed to use Amazon Bedrock.
data_description.secret_access_key: The secret access key belonging to the access key ID.

data.max_tokens: Maximum tokens to return in response

data_description.prompt: Instruct how the LLM should respond. This can be a template.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Allow the LLM to control Home Assistant using the selected API.
data_description.recommended: Use the recommended model and settings. Disable to choose a model, tune the settings or use a Bedrock Agent.
data_description.chat_model: The model ID or inference profile ID to use with the Converse API.
data_description.max_tokens: The maximum number of tokens the model may generate in a response.
data_description.temperature: Controls the randomness of the response. Lower values make the response more focused.
data_description.top_p: Limits the response to the most likely tokens whose probabilities add up to this value.
data_description.agent_id: Send conversations to a Bedrock Agent instead of a model. The agent uses its own instructions, tools and knowledge bases, so the model, instructions and Home Assistant control settings are ignored.
data_description.agent_alias_id: The alias of the Bedrock Agent to use. TSTALIASID is the working draft of the agent.

generate_content.name: Generate content
generate_content.description: Generate content from a prompt consisting of text and optionally images.

config_entry.name: Config entry
config_entry.description: The config entry to use for this action.

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.example: Describe what you see in these images

model.name: [%key:common::generic::model%]
model.description: The model ID to use. Defaults to the model of the conversation agent.

image_filename.name: Image filename
image_filename.description: Images to include in the prompt.
